{{Vanilla|Dye}}
{{Infobox auto|White Dye|title=Dyes}}
'''Dyes''' color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, banners, beds, [[sack]]s and other blocks. The sixteen dyes work as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. Matcha Flavoured changes where several of them come from: most of the new recipes give more dye per ingredient, and several turn common or renamed materials into dye.

The table lists every dye recipe that differs from vanilla. Dyes not listed are made only the vanilla way.

The vanilla recipes in the last column are blocked in the datapack's <code>pack.mcmeta</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

Because many flowers can be cloned with a water bottle and bone meal (see [[Hyacinth#Cloning]]), flower dyes are also renewable in bulk.

== Usage ==
Dyes are used as in vanilla. In the pack's own recipes:
* Black dye turns eight [[malachite]] into [[Malachite#Dark Malachite|dark malachite]].
* Yellow, lime and magenta dye choose the color of [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]].
* Lime dye and [[dough]] make 2 slimeballs.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/slime_ball_from_dough.json}}</ref>
* Red dye is used in the [[Prayer of Ares]].
